Toyota attributes vehicle issue to fuel contamination, not E20 petrol

Toyota Kirloskar Motor has stated that a viral video showing an Innova Hycross experiencing engine issues was caused by contaminated petrol, not the E20 fuel blend. The company clarified that vehicles compatible with E20 fuel are not facing difficulties. This statement comes amid broader discussions and concerns regarding the government's ethanol-blending program.
